title: Word statistics with slices
description:
Work on text through `&str` slices without copying it.

```
text: "the quick brown fox jumps"
first word: "the"
longest word: "quick"
last word: "jumps"
words: 5
```
hints: `.max_by_key(|w| w.len())` returns the last of equal words; to keep the first, loop and replace only when longer.
requirements: They return slices of the original text, not new `String`s.
An empty text gives `""` from each.
stretch: Write `fn trim_word<'a>(s: &'a str, n: usize) -> &'a str` that returns the first `n` characters of each word, without breaking a multi-byte character.
